Name: HorseCarriageMod
Author: Asakohee
Description:
This mod replaces the bus with a carriage, modifying dialogue, maps, and textures accordingly.

[b]Visual Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*]Replaces the bus with a horse-drawn carriage pulled by two horses.
[*]Seasonal carriage designs.
[*]Updates Joja Membership imagery.
[/list][b]Automatic Dialogue Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*]All mentions of "bus" are changed to "carriage."
[*]The bus driver is now a "coachman."
[*]The bus stop becomes a "carriage station."
[*]Note: Chinese and Japanese do not support automatic changes. Refer to the mod instructions to create additional CP mods if needed.
[/list][b]Sound Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*]Replaces bus sounds with carriage sounds.
[/list][b]Installation[/b]:
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[*]Extract the mod's zip file into your Mods folder.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Install SMAPI and Content Patcher. Then, extract the mod's zip file into your Mods folder.
